description: Business owner walkthrough (TR-53): a welding supply seller looking for customers in Phoenix. Two follow-up questions, then the business owner brief from criteria/examples.ts.

whenUserSays.pattern: ^I sell welding supplies, looking for customers in Phoenix$

reply.message: Welding supplies sound like a fit for fabrication shops. Who should I look for at those businesses: owners, operations managers or general managers?
Got it. What size of company suits you, and how many businesses should the list have?
Here's what I understood: businesses in Phoenix, AZ, preferring fabrication, owners and 10 to 99 employees, with 40 in the list.
